name: Rogue Advanced Talents and Ninja Master Tricks (Everyman Gaming, LLC)
category: Everyman Gaming, LLC – Slayer Advanced Talents
body:
Prerequisite(s): Advanced talents

Benefit(s): A slayer can select any of the following unchained rogue advanced talents or ninja master tricks in place of a slayer advanced talent: crippling strike*, deadly sneak*, evasion UC, feat, hunter’s surprise, knockout blow, master of disguise, opportunist, quick shot, stealthy sniper, and terrain mastery, greater. A slayer can select multiple rogue advanced talents or ninja master tricks by taking this slayer advanced talent multiple times, but can’t select the same one more than once.
